sources.entry: gzip - (Python standard library) Read and write gzip-compressed files and data.

summary.name: gzip
summary.one_liner: Python standard library module for reading, writing, compressing and decompressing gzip-format files and data.
use_cases: Writing compressed log or data files
Compressing a file or byte string in a script
Producing reproducible gzip output with mtime=0
summary.what_it_does:
The module provides a GzipFile class and gzip.open(), gzip.compress() and gzip.decompress() functions that mirror the GNU gzip and gunzip programs. GzipFile behaves like an ordinary file object, compressing or decompressing data on the fly, and supports binary and text modes via open(). Compression level ranges from 0 (none) to 9 (best), with 6 as the default. The data compression itself is handled by the zlib module. The module also includes a simple command-line interface with --fast, --best and -d options.</what_it_does>
<parameter name="pricing">open source
notable: Part of the Python standard library; API mirrors GNU gzip/gunzip behavior
gzip.compress() defaults mtime to 0 for reproducible output
Optional python-isal package can speed up (de)compression with a mostly compatible API
caveats: Does not support other formats decompressible by gzip, such as compress and pack output
Module is optional; may be missing from some CPython distributions
